rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice for saying that a day, trip, or event had nothing noteworthy happen.

example.english: Yesterday was uneventful from work to home.
example.traditional: 我尋日返工放工都冇乜特別。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 faan1 gung1 fong3 gung1 dou1 mou5 mat1 dak6 bit6

rows.note: Use this for a period of life, story, or routine that is uneventful in a monotonous or unexciting way.

example.english: That period of my life was very uneventful.
example.jyutping: go2 dyun6 jat6 zi2 gwo3 dak1 hou2 ping4 daam6

rows.note: Use this when the period or situation was calm and free of trouble, rather than merely lacking interesting events.

example.english: The whole trip was uneventful and trouble-free.
example.jyutping: seng4 go3 leoi5 cing4 dou1 fung1 ping4 long6 zing6
